design_notes:
Method: absorbed solar and Earth infrared heat plus internal dissipation equals radiated heat. Solve for one bulk temperature.
Valid range: environment cases named in the measures. A single node hides gradients, so treat the result as a screening value.
What varies per spacecraft: surface finish, areas, internal power, and temperature limits.
Assumption: the spacecraft is isothermal.

terms.name: absorptivity
terms.description: Solar absorptivity of the outer surface

terms.name: emissivity
terms.description: Infrared emissivity of the outer surface

terms.name: projected_area_m2
terms.description: Area facing the sun and the Earth

terms.name: radiating_area_m2
terms.description: Total area that radiates to space

terms.name: passes
terms.description: True when the design meets the requirement
